_comment: ST-4 fixture class registry (TASK-985 D7 dossier / BP-1..QW-12). SCAFFOLDING ONLY: this file adds no audio. Each class self-skips with a clear reason when its files are absent, exactly like the existing clinical/*.wav fixtures already do in test_streaming_quality_scorecard.py. The orchestrator (or a future ticket) drops real, de-identified audio into these directories/env vars; nothing in this manifest invents a reference transcript or a keyterm list.

stop_flush.description: Short single-final clinical reads (the existing 3-clip cardiology/discharge/medication set). The STOP-FLUSH regression-gate class (M-11): noisier by design because one final IS the whole utterance.

steady_state.description: >=60s continuous multi-final clinical speech. The STEADY-STATE gate class (M-11): tighter bounds, averages over many commits instead of the cold-open/tail-flush transient the stop-flush clips are dominated by.
steady_state.skip_reason: no >=60s steady-state clip committed yet (ST-4 scaffolding only -- real clinical audio is never committed to git)

noise_augmented.description: Deterministic noise-augmented variants of the stop-flush English clips (additive noise at fixed SNR, reproducible seed).
noise_augmented.skip_reason: no noise-augmented clip variants committed yet (ST-4 scaffolding only)

silence.description: Silence-only clip -- a negative control that must never emit a spurious final.
silence.skip_reason: no silence-only clip committed yet (ST-4 scaffolding only)

room_tone.description: Room-tone-only clip -- a negative control that must never emit a spurious final (BP-7/QW-13 companion).
room_tone.skip_reason: no room-tone clip committed yet (ST-4 scaffolding only)

two_speaker.description: One real de-identified two-speaker WAV with forced-alignment turns -- the diarization baseline M-12 names as null today.
two_speaker.skip_reason: two_speaker_consult_01.turns.json is committed but the WAV is not (ST-4 scaffolding only -- real audio is never committed to git)

ml_en.description: The 24 de-identified ml-en clinical clips (owner-supplied, held outside git) scored THROUGH THE WS GATEWAY with CER + Latin ratio -- distinct from test_mlen_quality_gate.py's offline single-utterance model-only gate (M-12's 'the ml-en gate is offline, single-utterance, prompts off').
ml_en.skip_reason_needs_env: STT_MLEN_EVAL_DIR is not set (ST-4 scaffolding only)
